description: An embedding model served by Voyage AI. No service has been run against Voyage itself.

model.description: The model asked for, by Voyage's name for it.

endpoint.description: The whole address of Voyage's embeddings call (`https://api.voyageai.com/v1/embeddings`).

apiKeyEnv.description: The environment variable holding the Voyage API key. The key is never a value here.
